column3: The Hebrew has His foundation on holy mountains, without the active founded or the supplied city in BSB.
The Hebrew says spoken of you; BSB says ascribed to you.
The Hebrew says there, not explicitly in Zion, and does not add when I say as BSB does.
The Hebrew repeats man and man, using a singular birth verb; BSB uses were born for this one and that one.
The Hebrew says there without explicitly naming Zion as BSB does.
The Hebrew compares singers with dancers and names springs without the added of joy or an explicit will proclaim in BSB.
